# Executive coaches

If you are an executive coach in the movement and would like to be added to this list, please email [angel@joinhive.org](mailto:angel@joinhive.org) with your name, a link to your website, your specialization (in a few words), and whether you offer paid or free services, or both.

| Name | Specialization | Website | Free/paid |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Adam Tury](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/adam-tury) | Effective altruism managers and leaders | [www.adamtury.com](https://www.adamtury.com/) | Paid |
| [Amruza Birdie (Reveal Impact)](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/amruza-birdie-reveal-impact) | Leadership & management coaching for all career stages | [revealimpact.com/](http://revealimpact.com/) | FreePaid |
| [Andreas Seltzer (Know Your Elephants)](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/andreas-seltzer-know-your-elephants) | Consulting for non-profit organizations and social impact initiatives | [www.knowyourelephants.com](https://www.knowyourelephants.com/en/) | Paid |
| [Katie Glass](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/katie-glass) | Women and non-binary | [www.katieglass.com](https://www.katieglass.com/) | Paid |
| [PEPR Global](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/pepr-global) | Leadership thought partner, consultancy | [www.peprglobal.org](https://www.peprglobal.org/) | FreePaid |
| [Vadivu Govind (Inner Wealth)](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/vadivu-govind-inner-wealth) | Positive, compassionate, deep-impact leadership; workplace wellbeing | [innerwealth.global](https://innerwealth.global/services/) | Paid |
| [Ronan Kennedy](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/ronan-kennedy) | Communication, leadership, personal branding, and confidence | [ronankennedy.ie/](http://ronankennedy.ie/) | FreePaid |
| [Scarlet Spark](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/scarlet-spark) | Consultancy that can include executive coaching | [www.scarletspark.org](https://www.scarletspark.org/solutions) | Free |
| [Hayley Cooper](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/hayley-cooper) | Holistic career clarity (affordable rates) | [www.wilddreamscoaching.com](http://www.wilddreamscoaching.com/) | Paid |
| [Sofia Balderson](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/sofia-balderson) | Early stage founders/leaders, new managers | [www.sofiabalderson.com](https://www.sofiabalderson.com/) | Paid |

# エグゼクティブ・コーチ

この運動に携わるエグゼクティブ・コーチの方で、このリストへの掲載をご希望の場合は、お名前、ウェブサイトへのリンク、専門分野（簡潔に）、および有料・無料のどちらのサービスを提供しているか（あるいはその両方か）を明記の上、[angel@joinhive.org](mailto:angel@joinhive.org) までメールをお送りください。

| Name | Specialization | ウェブサイト | Free/paid |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [アダム・トゥリー](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/adam-tury) | 効果的利他主義のマネージャーとリーダー | [www.adamtury.com](https://www.adamtury.com/) | 有料 |
| [アムルザ・バーディー（リヴィール・インパクト）](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/amruza-birdie-reveal-impact) | あらゆるキャリア段階におけるリーダーシップ・マネジメント・コーチング | [revealimpact.com/](http://revealimpact.com/) | 無料・有料 |
| [アンドレアス・ゼルツァー（『Know Your Elephants』）](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/andreas-seltzer-know-your-elephants) | 非営利団体および社会的インパクトを目的とした取り組みに対するコンサルティング | [www.knowyourelephants.com](https://www.knowyourelephants.com/en/) | 有料 |
| [ケイティ・グラス](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/katie-glass) | 女性およびノンバイナリー | [www.katieglass.com](https://www.katieglass.com/) | 有料 |
| [PEPR Global](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/pepr-global) | リーダーシップ・シンクパートナー、コンサルティング会社 | [www.peprglobal.org](https://www.peprglobal.org/) | 無料・有料 |
| [ヴァディヴ・ゴヴィンド（『インナー・ウェルス』）](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/vadivu-govind-inner-wealth) | 前向きで思いやりにあふれ、深い影響力を持つリーダーシップ；職場のウェルビーイング | [innerwealth.global](https://innerwealth.global/services/) | 有料 |
| [ロナン・ケネディ](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/ronan-kennedy) | コミュニケーション、リーダーシップ、パーソナルブランディング、そして自信 | [ronankennedy.ie/](http://ronankennedy.ie/) | 無料・有料 |
| [スカーレット・スパーク](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/scarlet-spark) | エグゼクティブ・コーチングを含むコンサルティング | [www.scarletspark.org](https://www.scarletspark.org/solutions) | 無料 |
| [ヘイリー・クーパー](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/hayley-cooper) | 包括的なキャリアの方向性の明確化（手頃な料金） | [www.wilddreamscoaching.com](http://www.wilddreamscoaching.com/) | 有料 |
| [ソフィア・バルダーソン](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/building-organisations/executive-coaches/sofia-balderson) | 創業初期の創業者・リーダー、新任のマネージャー | [www.sofiabalderson.com](https://www.sofiabalderson.com/) | 有料 |
